text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Commentary urges unlisted firms to consider indirect listing by acquiring shares in listed firms.
- Industry sources welcome the new rules to ban serious rule violators from the securities industry for good.
- BUSINESS NEWS - The first day of the East China Trade Fair reported a turnover of $34.49 million.
- Taxi company Qiangsheng has made use of its listed subsidiary, Pudong Qiangsheng Co Ltd, to improve its performance.
- Shanghai's textile industry moved into profit from August last year, reversing years of loss-making.
